title: Taide slams 3rd straight fifty

 Taide slams 3rd straight fifty    Date :19-Nov-2026 
     Special Correspondent :   VIDARBHA captain Atharva 
Taide is on song this Syed 
Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy season. 
The left-handed opener 
slammed his third successive 
half-century to guide Vidarbha 
to a three-wicket win over 
Hyderabad, on Wednesday. 
After hitting 52 (42 balls) 
against Goa in the opener and 
then 74 (48) against Odisha, Taide 
continued his dominant form 
against Hyderabad at Eden 
Gardens in Kolkata slamming a 
45-ball 82 as Vidarbha chased 
down the 196 runs target in 19.2 
overs. With three fifties from as 
many games, Taide zoomed to 
second spot in SMAT batters 
ranking with 208 runs at a strike 
rate of 154.07. 
Delhi batter Yash Dhull tops 
the chart with 224 runs from 
three matches. 
Tiade, who went unsold last IPL 
auction, might have forced IPL 
franchises to include his name 
in their list when the mini-auction takes place next month in 
Goa.   
Hyderabad managed to score 
a competitive 195 from 20 overs. 
Opener Tanmay Agarwal hit a 
24-ball 49 while Kodimela 
Himateja scored 41 from 33 balls. 
For Vidarbha, pacers Nachiket 
Bhute (1-34) and Saurabh Dubey 
(2-30) shared three wickets whileAdhyayan Daga (1-41), YashKadam (2-21) and Varun Bisht (1-23) snared a total of four wickets. Vidarbha changed the opening pair as Adhyayan Daga joinedcaptain Taide at the top. The decision could not give a positiveresult as Daga (15) was sent backin the fourth over. 
Taide, who slammed 11 boundaries and three sixes in his 45- 
ball innings, added 29 runs for 
the second wicket with DanishMalewar (12) and 48 runs withVedant Jajoo (7) for the fourthwicket. After Taide’s departure, 
Shubham Dubey (15*) and Bisht 
(22*) put up an unseparated 32runs for eighth wicket as Vidarbhacrossed the line in 19.2 overs.
